description: This Zenodo deposit packages harmonised spatial inputs for regional crop simulation in South Asia. The ACASA-BISA researchers assembled soil properties, crop management, phenology, irrigation and historical yield information to better represent variation among farming systems. Two public archives distinguish five-kilometre and fifty-kilometre grids, and a README accompanies them. The repository states CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a selected South Asian crop-modelling domain, not a measured record from every field or an operating irrigation-network map. Grid resolution, heterogeneous source years and downscaling assumptions are limitations for farm-scale or cross-border use. A reviewer-assessed use is setting soil and management conditions in crop-yield or food-security simulations. platform-global-food-twin is a related food-system resource, but no verified importer or model run joins the records. The article also links an ACASA code repository that returned HTTP 404 with authenticated GitHub access; a separate public companion holds additional crop tables. This record represents the Zenodo input deposit only. No archive or workbook was downloaded.
